name: Gas refilling
tagline: Fix the leak first, then charge it right
summary: Cooling checks and refrigerant service by experienced technicians.
description: Low refrigerant usually means there is a leak. Topping up without fixing it only buys a few weeks. We find and repair the leak first, then vacuum the system and charge the correct refrigerant (R22, R32, R410A and others) by weight and pressure, as the manufacturer specifies.
suitable_for: Split, window, cassette, tower and ductable ACs
includes: Leak detection and repair before refilling
System vacuuming to remove air and moisture
Accurate charging for R22, R32, R410A and more
signs: AC runs but cooling is weak
Ice or frost on the copper pipes
Hissing or bubbling sound from the unit

options.name: R410A gas refilling
options.detail: Common in inverter and commercial units

options.name: Leak repair + full charge
options.detail: Brazing, vacuum and full refrigerant charge

process.title: Pressure check
process.text: We measure system pressure to confirm whether gas is low.

process.title: Leak detection
process.text: Joints, coils and valves are checked to find the leak.

process.title: Repair & vacuum
process.text: We fix the leak, then vacuum out air and moisture.

process.title: Charge & test
process.text: Refrigerant is charged by weight, then cooling is verified.

faqs.question: Why does my AC need gas again?
faqs.answer: Refrigerant isn't used up. If it's low, there's a leak, and we repair it so you don't need repeated refills.

faqs.question: Can a top-up be done instead of a full charge?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. If the leak is small and repaired, a top-up may be enough; otherwise a full recharge gives accurate performance.
